name: The Spire Transparency Projection — Unsanctioned, 2196
creator: Deadlight Mural Collective / unknown technical collaborators
description: On the night of November 11, 2196, the Deadlight Mural Collective and unidentified technical partners hijacked the Spire's exterior architectural lighting grid — a system designed to display approved corporate branding — and projected forty minutes of leaked HelixCorp internal financial data, executive compensation figures, and the Gray Zone resource allocation documents across the visible face of the building in twelve-meter-high text, readable from Tier 1 through Tier 4. The projection ran until HelixCorp cut power to the entire building's external systems, briefly darkening the Spire for the first time in recorded memory.
medium: large-scale projection, physical visibility, neural-captured by thousands
cultural_impact: The image of the Spire dark — reproduced in neural feeds, murals, and eventually official art histories — became the defining visual symbol of anti-corponation sentiment in late 2190s GLMZ.
controversy: HelixCorp prosecuted eleven people for the projection, none of whom were provably responsible; legal observers noted the prosecutions appeared designed to intimidate rather than convict. All eleven were acquitted by 2198.
story_hooks: The technical expertise required to breach the Spire's lighting grid exceeded anything Deadlight was known to possess — someone with inside access helped, and they have never been identified.
The leaked financial documents projected that night contained one line item that was never publicly discussed — a recurring transfer to an entity with no registered existence.
A character finds a physical photograph of the dark Spire taken from a Tier 1 rooftop — on the back, in handwriting, is a date three years in the future.
